Packet.scope: native virtual ABI, independent of the wire protocol field ordering
Packet.evidence: Exact-build movement packet tables: getId slot1 and isValid slot11; no per-packet function address required by the SDK accessor. See REA freecam/auth-valid-evidence.json and move-valid-evidence.json; Windows RCX and AL checked in exact PE disassembly.

runtime_validation.scope: getID slot1 used for packet routing; isValid slot11 remains a static ABI candidate
limitations: Confirmation applies to the exercised Mod behavior; optional branches, other origins and all object lifetimes are not individually established.

packet_deferral.evidence: Exact-build PE: the three LegacyClientNetworkHandler shared_ptr handle overloads were located from the std::function type_info of their queued lambdas (lambda_92/93/97), then confirmed three ways: the handler body contains the lea of that callable table, the handler is the target of vtable 0xF2D1E20 at the recorded slot, and the by-value shared_ptr release epilogue uses the recorded control-block offsets. Deferral holds that reference and replays the handler on the game thread; nothing writes game memory. Evidence: ~/Documents/PEXData/diet/evidence-11-packet-slot.md.

Network::handleUpdateBlockSyncedPacket.source: Exact 1.26.65.1 PE: .pdata range 0x6BD5420-0x6BD5526. Handler body materialises the std::function callable table 0xF2D2E50 (slot 2 = 0x6BF0E80, slot 3 = 0x6BF0F50, whose lea target is the lambda_92 type descriptor 0x125E1610) and is the function in vtable 0xF2D1E20 at slot 228. It is byte-identical to the UpdateBlock entry except the callable lea and the CFG dispatch slot. Evidence: ~/Documents/PEXData/diet/evidence-11-packet-slot.md.
Network::handleUpdateBlockSyncedPacket.abi: void __fastcall(void* self RCX, const void* networkIdentifier RDX, void* sharedPtr<Packet> R8)

Network::handleUpdateBlockPacket.source: Exact 1.26.65.1 PE: .pdata range 0x6BD55A0-0x6BD56A6. Handler body materialises the std::function callable table 0xF2D2E80 (slot 2 = 0x6BF0FE0, slot 3 = 0x6BF10B0, whose lea target is the lambda_93 type descriptor 0x125E16B0) and is the function in vtable 0xF2D1E20 at slot 229. Signature: RCX = handler this (first qword must be 0x140F2D1E20), RDX = NetworkIdentifier* (0xB0 bytes copied by the handler with one memcpy), R8 = by-value shared_ptr<Packet> (object at +0, control at +8). The epilogue releases that by-value reference (lock dec [ctrl+8]; _Destroy via ctrl vtable slot 0; lock dec [ctrl+0xC]; _Delete_this via slot 1). Evidence: ~/Documents/PEXData/diet/evidence-11-packet-slot.md.
Network::handleUpdateBlockPacket.abi: void __fastcall(void* self RCX, const void* networkIdentifier RDX, void* sharedPtr<Packet> R8)
